activities.name: Whales off Atauro Island
activities.note: Atauro sits beside one of the deepest ocean channels in Asia, which is why the migration passes so close to shore

windows.reason: whales and dolphins are seen year round but are particularly abundant from October to December, including blue whales, humpbacks, pilot whales and orca

activities.name: Mount Ramelau (Tatamailau)
activities.note: climbed from Hato Bulico to a summit statue of the Virgin Mary; an annual pilgrimage goes up around 25 March

windows.reason: the dry season, when you can camp on the saddle below the summit for sunset and sunrise
the wet season: the summit gets cold, wet and windy and the Hato Bulico road can become dangerous or impassable

activities.name: Diving off Atauro Island
activities.note: Atauro is the country's most pristine diving area

windows.reason: May to November is the best time for diving of any kind
